comment: The three optional tips the apps sell, as both stores list them. Names: the apps' own strings (App/Resources/Localizable.xcstrings, android res/values-*/strings.xml, kept equal by a test). Prices: what the buyer pays in euros. Read by .github/scripts/asset_library.py (iap_create) and play_tips.py.
